senses.gloss:
(इ) निदि r. 1st cl. (निन्दति)
To reproach, to blame.

m. (-दः)
Poison, venom.
E.
नि affirmative prefix, दो to destroy, affix ड.

mfn. (-त्तः-त्ता-त्तं)
Given, given absolutely.
E.
नि, and दत्त given.

m. (-द्रुः)
A man.
E.
निद poison, and द्रु tree, a living Upas.

n. (-नं)
1 An example or illustration.
2 Injunction, precept.
3 Tenour, purport.
4 Authority, text.
E.
नि fully or certainly, दर्शन showing.

m. (-घः)
1 The hot season, (May and June.)
2 Heat, warmth.
3 Sweat, perspiration.
E.
नि always, दह to burn, घञ् affix, and घ substituted for ह.

m. (-रः)
The sun.
E.
निदाघ the hot season, and कर who makes.

m. (-लः)
The hot season, two months previous to the rains, about May and June.
E.
निदाघ, and काल time or season.

m. (-न्धुः)
A river in the hot weather, one nearly dry.
E.
निदाघ, and सिन्धु a river.

n. (-नं)
1 A first cause, a primary or remote cause.
2 Disappearance, cessation or removal of a first cause.
3 Purification, purity, correctness.
4 Asking for the recompense or objects of austere devotion.
5 End, cessation.
6 A rope for tying a calf.
7 Ascertaining the causes of disease, study of symptoms with a view to trace the remote or proximate causes; hence this word is the name of a division of all works on medicine.
E.
नि always or certainly, दा to give, affix ल्युट्; by which all effects are produced.

mfn. (-ग्धः-ग्धा-ग्धं)
Smeared, anointed, plastered.
f. (-ग्धा)
Small cardamoms.
E.
नि prefixed to दिह to smear, affix क्त.

f. (-का)
A sort of prickly nightshade, (Solanum jacquini.)
E.
कन् added to the preceding.

n. (-नं)
Deep and repeated consideration, thinking of or recalling repeatedly.
E.
नि before ध्यै in the reiterative form, affix ल्यु.

mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं)
1 Ordered, directed.
2 Advised, enjoined.
3 Explained, pointed out.
E.
नि implying certainty, दिश to show, affix क्त.

m. (-शः)
A fish.

m. (-शः)
1 Order, command, direction, instruction.
2 Speech, speaking, saying, relating.
3 Vicinity, proximity.
4 The word of command.
E.
नि verily, दिश to show, affix घञ्.

mfn. (-शी-शिनी-शि)
Showing, directing, pointing out.
f. (-नी)
A quarter of space.
E.
नि before दिश to show, णिनि aff.

mfn. (-ष्टा-ष्ट्री-ष्टृ)
Who or what shows or points out, explaining, advising, commanding, &c.
E.
नि before दिश to show, तृच् aff.

f. (-द्रा)
Sleep, sleepiness, sloth.
E.
णिद to condemn or censure, Uṇādi affix रक्; or द्रै to sleep, affix क्विप्, and नि prefixed.

mfn. (-णः-णा-णं)
1 Asleep, sleepy, drowsy.
2 Shut up, closed.
E.
निद्रा as above, affix क्त.

mfn. (-द्रान्-द्रान्ती-द्रात्)
Sleeping.
E.
नि before द्रा to go, affix शतृ.

mfn. (-ङ्गः-ङ्गा-ङ्गं)
Awaked, aroused from sleep.
E.
निद्रा, भङ्ग breaking.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
Sleeping, asleep.
E.
नि before द्रै to sleep, शानच् aff.

mfn. (-लुः-लुः-लु)
Sleeping, sleepy, drowsy, slothful.
f. (-लुः)
A sort of perfume, commonly नीली.
E.
निद्रा, and आलुच् aff.

m. (-क्षः)
Darkness.
E.
निद्रा sleep, and वृक्ष a tree, (whose fruit is sleep.)

n. (-नं)
Phlegm, phlegmatic^1 humour.
E.
निद्रा sleep, and संजनन producing, occasioning.
[1] Correction submitted by Dr. Sampada Savardekar on 20210731. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/csl-corrections/issues/66.
